meta.subject: WIP: flush on kernel finish (by yff)

en.summary: This WIP commit primarily adds a new end-of-kernel or end-of-workgroup D-cache flush path and changes cache geometry, so it is better treated as feature bring-up than as a clean standalone DUT bug-fix record.
why_it_counts: The patch does touch real cache, LSU, and warp-scheduler RTL, so it needed direct inspection rather than dismissal from the subject line alone.
disqualifiers: The commit is explicitly marked WIP.
Its primary substance is adding a new flushDCache control path across warp_scheduler, pipe, and LSU.
The same patch also changes cache parameters such as dcache_NSets, dcache_BlockWords, and l2cache_NSets, which is bring-up or configuration work rather than a focused bug fix.
The concrete cache-control fixes embedded in the patch overlap with cleaner bug-fix commits already represented elsewhere in this series.
evidence: warp_schedule.scala adds new per-workgroup completion tracking and a new flushDCache Decoupled interface.
pipe.scala wires the new flushDCache path into LSU, and LSU.scala adds new flush_dcache handling and flush-only state transitions.
parameters.scala changes D-cache and L2 geometry in the same commit.
tests.scala is also modified to change test timing.

disqualifiers: 提交本身明确标记为 WIP。
其主要内容是在 warp_scheduler、pipe 和 LSU 之间新增 flushDCache 控制路径。
同一补丁还修改了 dcache_NSets、dcache_BlockWords、l2cache_NSets 等缓存参数，这更像 bring-up 或配置变更，而不是单一 bug 修复。
补丁中夹带的具体 cache 控制修复点，与同一系列里更干净的独立 bug-fix 提交存在重叠。
